experiments: Four bridge cases staged in the run sandbox (V0 N+1 counting, V2 locking experiment with threads, V1 SQLite docs, V4 Prisma v6 docs), plus V3 executed in the Z.ai sandbox VM with Prisma 6.19.2 as supplementary labeled evidence (output preserved at scripts/verifications/exp010/v3-prisma-experiment-output.txt).

cases.name: V0 N+1 measurement: loop pattern grows (N+1), single JOIN constant (1)
cases.objective: verify the record's core MEASURE-FIRST claim on real SQLite: query count grows linearly with rows for the loop pattern and stays constant for the batched read

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, loop executes exactly N+1=501 queries, JOIN exactly 1, loop slower
expected.failureCriteria: counts differ or latency relationship not reproduced

cases.name: V2 SQLite locking experiment: lock error, busy timeout, WAL concurrency
cases.objective: verify the corrected locking explanation experimentally: second writer blocked during an open write transaction; busy timeout defers; WAL allows readers during a pending write while writers still serialize

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, 'database is locked' with short timeout, success with real timeout, WAL reader proceeds, WAL second writer blocked
expected.failureCriteria: any of the four locking observations not reproduced

cases.name: V1 doc-based: SQLite lock states, WAL one-writer, busy handler (live fetch)
cases.objective: verify the corrected locking explanation against the ACTUAL official SQLite documentation

expected.expectedResult: V1-DOC-VERIFIED with quotes from lockingv3, wal and busy_timeout pages
expected.successCriteria: exit 0, RESERVED/PENDING state definitions found, one-writer-at-a-time found, busy-handler statement found
expected.failureCriteria: doc fetch fails or documented statements differ from the record's explanation

cases.name: V4 doc-based: Prisma v6 query logging + N+1 definition + batching nuance (live fetch)
cases.objective: verify against the ACTUAL official Prisma v6 docs (installed major version): logging configuration, the n+1 definition, and the documented batching nuance

expected.expectedResult: V4-DOC-VERIFIED with quotes from the logging and query-optimization pages
expected.successCriteria: exit 0, logging constructor + log array + events found, n+1 definition found, findMany batching nuance found
expected.failureCriteria: doc fetch fails or documented statements differ
